lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected outcomes.
Evidence is still too thin to establish rules for specific kinds of changes, as no change type has been tested at least twice.
No kind of change has been proven helpful yet, as no test has yielded a statistically significant win.

candidates.title: Choose Path Spotlight Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a spotlight layout to highlight path options clearly.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop out on choose_path, taking a median of 8s and mean of 514s.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of choose_path screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 23.8% of users, but redesigns have previously yielded negative lift (-1.4%).

candidates.title: Account Sync Benefits Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated information screen before sign-in explaining how account creation protects pet data from resetting.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in drops 27.1% of users.

new_account_benefits.headline: Keep Your Pet Safe
new_account_benefits.body: Signing in backs up your pet memory and items to the cloud so your companion is never lost.

guard.reason: screen 'new_account_benefits' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Split Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a split layout showing the pet preview alongside adoption details.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 39.1% with long completion times (mean 1017s).

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout is permitted as long as core functions remain.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 39.1% of users, but previous adoption redesign test resulted in -1.4% lift.

candidates.title: Interactive Welcome Tour Flow
candidates.change: Add a new welcome tour step right after home_intro explaining how to interact, hide, and summon the pet on desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on controlling or talking to the pet, and 35.2% drop at the finish step.

new_welcome_tour.headline: How to Interact With Your Pet
new_welcome_tour.body: Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen. Use the system tray icon to open options or hide your companion.

guard.reason: Adding a new tour screen after home_intro is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel (35.2% drop) and 3 support emails point to this issue; finish new_flow previously showed +1.9% lift.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Generation Progress Timer
candidates.change: Show a time estimate and helpful tips carousel on the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing users to abandon or wait idly.

components.text: Your pet is being prepared! You can position your companion anywhere on desktop when ready.

guard.reason: Time estimate on waiting screen represents a real wait and is permitted.

candidates.score_note: High wait time (mean 2336s) on home step supported by funnel data; low risk progress indicator.

candidates.title: Path Selection Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Display a explicit hint under path options reassuring users they can change their choice in settings later.
candidates.why: Decision friction on choose_path leads to long mean duration (514s) and 23.8% abandonment.

choose_path.hint: Don't worry, you can switch or adjust your path preferences anytime later in app settings.

guard.reason: Adding reassurance copy to choose_path is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 23.8% drop on choose_path with a low-cost, config-like hint addition.

candidates.title: Sign In Safe Restore Headline
candidates.change: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to clarify that signing in protects save progress across logins.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited reset or missing pet data after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Save & Secure Your Pet Progress
sign_in.body: Connect an account so your companion settings and memory are safely saved to the cloud.

guard.reason: Updating sign_in copy within onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence with 8 support emails and funnel data; simple text copy change with high cost-efficiency.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Notification Opt-in
candidates.change: Add a desktop notification switch to the waiting screen so users get notified when generation finishes.
candidates.why: High mean wait duration on home (2336s) indicates users switch away while waiting.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: We'll notify you as soon as your companion is ready to appear on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a notification opt-in toggle to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses home step abandonments during 2336s mean wait time by adding notification opt-in.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Stage Layout
candidates.change: Switch the pick_friend screen to a stage layout to showcase pet options prominently.
candidates.why: The adoption step has high drop-off (39.1%) and high time taken (mean 1017s).

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend layout within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has 39.1% drop, but UI layout/redesign experiments on adoption have shown poor outcomes so far.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Bonus Badge
candidates.change: Add an early companion reward badge component to the home intro screen.
candidates.why: 35.2% of users drop off at the final finish step before completing onboarding.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy cannot mention gifts, bonuses, or free extras ('Early Companion Unlocked!').

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected outcomes across most tests.
For finish, new_flow (2 tests), no statistically significant win was achieved and no clear effect was seen, despite positive noise-corrected averages (+2.2%).
Evidence is still too thin to establish rules for adoption (new_flow, redesign), finish (new_screen), and sign_in (reorder), as each has only one test.
No kind of change has been proven helpful yet, as no test has yielded a statistically significant win.
